audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart 'why' text for Levels 1-2 was generic template ('Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds') while the side column says Aatrox wins those levels — the prose contradicted the rating.
audit.why: Aatrox has The Darkin Blade from level 1 on a 14s cooldown; Malphite has Seismic Shard chip and nothing else. The lane difficulty is 'lose the first five levels, then take over on armour'.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0].why and phases[1].why to state Aatrox's real early advantage and the cooldown gap Malphite steps into.

audit.why: Power spikes are accurately placed: Aatrox at 3 (all three Q casts, Infernal Chains, passive heal), Malphite at 6 and again on first armour item. Content spikes[] and full phases[] agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Darkin Blade was described as 'sweetspots knock up' with no cooldown, and Infernal Chains was never named or timed.
audit.why: Riot's text: The Darkin Blade is three swings on 14/12/10/8/6; only the edge of the third swing knocks up, so sidestepping OUTWARD is the counterplay, not backing straight off. Infernal Chains (20/18/16/14/12) is his only way to hold Malphite in the combo — it is the cooldown that gates his all-in, not Q.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names both abilities with rank-1 and rank-5 numbers and states the sidestep direction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'Skip anti-heal' Don't had a description copy-pasted from the trade-bad line about Granite Shield — the title promised anti-heal and the body never mentioned it.
audit.why: Aatrox heals from Deathbringer Stance, from Umbral Dash's passive on every damaging hit, and World Ender amplifies all of it. Malphite's armour build already routes through Bramble Vest, so the Grievous Wounds timing is free if taken before level 6.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dontsFull[2].d to state the three heal sources and the Bramble Vest timing; content spikes[2] now leads with Bramble Vest.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Aatrox contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: He has The Darkin Blade on a 14s cooldown at rank 1 and you have no trade — farm behind Granite Shield and sidestep the edge sweetspot.

edits.before: Passive shield resets between trades — space until it is back. Only take the trade when Aatrox's The Darkin Blade is down.
edits.after: A second Q point cuts The Darkin Blade to 12s and Infernal Chains is 20s — step up only in the gap after he has spent the pull.

edits.before: - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: matchup-defining — Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep them. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — only the outer edge knocks up, so sidestep outward. - Infernal Chains: 20s at rank 1, his only hold — the all-in is gated on it. - Unstoppable Force: 130s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Trading with your passive shield down — that shield IS your trade margin; without it you are paying full price.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash heal him on every hit and World Ender amplifies it — buy Bramble Vest before his 6.

notes: dontsFull[2].d, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d in this entry (and in every Malphite entry I read) share one templated body text that does not match its own title. I only rewrote dontsFull[2].d here. The kit file flags Malphite's Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E) as 'grounding'; Riot's own descriptions say slow and attack-speed slow with no grounding, so I treated the flag as a tooltip-parse misfire and never claimed Malphite denies a dash with Q or E.
